SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
TUESDAY - MARCH 31, 2020 -
07:00 P.M.
TELECONFERENCE MEETING AUTHORIZED BY STATE OF CALIFORNIA EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20 AND N-29-20
VIA ZOOM VIDEO COMMUINICATIONS, MEETING ID# 938 485 040
*COVID-19 NOTICE*
To protect public health and safety during the local, state, and federally declared COVID-19 emergency, the City Council Chamber and City Hall are closed to the public. Consistent with State of California Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20 and the Los Angeles County Health Officer’s “Safer at Home Order for Control of COVID-19” the City Council will participate in the meeting through teleconference. Public participation in the meeting will be facilitated through the electronic methods as described below.
Agenda Materials:
The agenda and agenda packet related to items on this agenda are available for public inspection at www.cerritos.us. Materials submitted to the City Council/Successor Agency after distribution of the agenda packet will be made available for public inspection at www.cerritos.us.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION:
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at www.cerritos.us and on Cerritos TV3.
Public Comments:
Public comments are limited to the items listed on this Special Meeting agenda only. Members of the public may provide public comment through the following methods:
Email: Members of the public may provide public comment by submitting an email to city_clerk@cerritos.us by 5:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the meeting date and agenda item number for which you would like to provide comment in the subject line of the email. The public comment will be distributed to all members of the City Council and retained with the public record of the meeting.
Teleconference participation: You may provide audio public comment by connecting to the teleconference meeting online or by telephone/mobile call (please select only one method). Public speakers will be queued to provide comment at the appropriate time on the agenda. You must be available to provide comment at the time your connection is “unmuted.” If you are not planning on providing public comment we encourage you to observe the meeting via livestream or on Cerritos TV3 to allow staff to more effectively manage the number of teleconference connections.
Cerritos Zoom meeting online link: https://us04web.zoom.us/j/938485040
Cerritos Zoom Meeting call-in telephone number: 669-900-6833
Cerritos Zoom Meeting ID: 938 485 040
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) accommodations:
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk/Treasurer at 562-916-1248 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the teleconference meeting.

MINUTES OF A SPECIAL MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD ON
TUESDAY – MARCH 31, 2020 – 7:00 P.M., TELECONFERENCE MEETING
AUTHORIZED BY STATE OF CALIFORNIA EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20 AND
N-29-20, VIA ZOOM VIDEO COMMUNICATIONS, MEETING ID# 938 485 040

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Pledge of Allegiance

3.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Grace Hu
  Council/Agency Member Mark E. Pulido
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Frank A. Yokoyama
  Mayor/Chair Naresh Solanki

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Solanki, to excuse Council/Agency
  Member Edwards from the meeting (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (4 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Hu, Pulido, Yokoyama, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Edwards (excused)
  ABSTAIN:  None

4.  Public Comments

  Jim McMahon requested additional instructions on how the public can participate in
  the teleconference meetings and the total Cerritos voter participation numbers for
  the Tuesday, March 3, 2020 Cerritos General Municipal Election. He submitted a
  document for the record. (The document is a public record and a full-text copy can
  be obtained in the Office of the City Clerk/Treasurer).

  Murali Vasudevan encouraged residents to observe social distancing, inquired as to
  the City’s plan to enforce social distancing, and offered congratulations to the newly
  elected City Council members. He submitted a document for the record. (The
  document is a public record and a full-text copy can be obtained in the Office of the
  City Clerk/Treasurer).

  Katherine Chu appreciates the text alerts the City has provided and expressed
  concerns regarding coyotes and suspicious activity in the community.

  Kirit Chauhan congratulated the newly elected Councilmembers and inquired as to
  the City’s continuity plans as a result of the impact of the local emergency.

  Johanna Suarez inquired whether the City can work with local hotels to offer
  accommodations to health care workers.
 City of Cerritos  March 31, 2020
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 2 of 2

5.  New Business

5A.  Review and consideration of an information update on the City’s response to the
  COVID-19 local emergency (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Annie Hylton, City & Theater Marketing Manager/City
  Librarian. A PowerPoint presentation was displayed.

  The public was provided an opportunity to provide comment on all special meeting
  agenda items (Agenda Item 4) in accordance with the provisions of the California
  Brown Act.

  There was no further action taken on this item.

5B.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA RECITING THE FACTS OF THE
  GENERAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION HELD IN THE CITY ON TUESDAY, MARCH 3, 2020,
  DECLARING THE RESULT THEREOF AND SUCH OTHER MATTERS AS PROVIDED BY
  THE PROVISIONS OF THE CITY CHARTER (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Vida Barone, City Clerk/Elections Official. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed.

  The public was provided an opportunity to provide comment on all special meeting
  agenda items (Agenda Item 4) in accordance with the provisions of the California
  Brown Act.

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Solanki, to:

  1. Waive full reading of and adopt Resolution No. 2020-06, A RESOLUTION OF
  THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA RECITING
  THE FACTS OF THE GENERAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION HELD IN THE CITY ON
  TUESDAY, MARCH 3, 2020, DECLARING THE RESULT THEREOF AND SUCH
  OTHER MATTERS AS PROVIDED BY THE PROVISIONS OF THE CITY
  CHARTER; and

  2. Declare elected Jim Edwards, Naresh Solanki, and Chuong Vo to the Cerritos City
  Council for a full term of four (4) years each (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (4 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Hu, Pulido, Yokoyama, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Edwards (excused)
  ABSTAIN:  None

13.  Adjournment

  The meeting adjourned at 7:55 p.m.

ATTEST:
  /s/Vida Barone
  Vida Barone, City Clerk/Agency Secretary
/s/Naresh Solanki
Naresh Solanki, Mayor/Chair

APPROVED: April 9, 2020
